MeetingMind is a free AI meeting-notes app for Android and the web, available at meetingmind.org. It records and transcribes meetings (Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet via a visible meeting bot), phone calls and in-person conversations, writes summaries and action items, and answers questions about your recordings. Android 10+ on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kreativekoala.meetingmind
